notes: Experimental 2D body and feet model; not qualified for physical localization or unattended gestures.
Download the pinned ZIP, extract end2end.onnx, then upload that ONNX file on the selected processing server. Do not upload the ZIP or a PyTorch checkpoint.
Archive: 52089522 bytes, SHA256 55b81170e236040b59fc792ad0a8315301ac4c079a3bdb1095d838aad3088d18. Extracted ONNX: 55685444 bytes, verified against the manifest SHA256.
Top-down inference reuses person detections. No detector, tracker or model download runs inside pose inference.

Halpe26 landmarks retain their original names and raw SimCC scores, which are not probabilities and can exceed one. No global pose confidence is produced; the legacy pose score retains the source detection score.
The backend uses upright MMPose Python affine preprocessing, not the rounded MMDeploy SDK crop sampler. PyTorch export parity and anatomical accuracy require independent qualification.
No hip-relative 3D, depth or world pointing direction is supplied by this model. CPU is the only evaluated provider.
Toposync does not mirror, bundle or automatically download these weights; manual upload is the selected product policy.
